definition: NEDSFBA is an acronym for Neurodevelopmental disorder with early-onset seizures, facial dysmorphism, and behavioral abnormalities (OMIM #621390), a genetic neurodevelopmental disorder associated with pathogenic variants in the KLHL20 gene.
